description: Split a Requirement into a smaller one: `from_id` DECOMPOSES `to_id`. Use when a child is a 1:1 piece of its parent adding NO new information ("the app must have a checkout system" → enter-a-card, apply-a-discount, receive-a-receipt). Delivery rolls UP this edge: the parent is delivered when EVERY child is, so a decomposed parent needs no capability of its own. Do NOT use for a requirement that adds new technical necessity nobody asked for — that is *derived*, it belongs to the Decision that forced it (set_requirement_lineage `derived` + governed_by), and re-opening that decision may remove its reason to exist. Marks the child `decomposed`. Refuses a cycle: a tree that contains itself has no leaves and could never roll up.
name: decomposes
